title: Julie Devils Thumb: Depth and Color Grading in Post-Processing

date.basis: Embedded MP4 creation_time in metadata; file path indicates production window but no transcript-confirmed recording date.

summary: This video documents a landscape post-processing workflow focused on creating depth by separating foreground and background blacks and then refining color and light. The presenter applies a large Gaussian blur to the background, increases luminosity with whites adjustments, and uses the History Brush to restore select details. A subsequent blur and a dehaze-like pass on the left refine the separation and reintroduce the foreground. The color pass employs a selective color technique described as “50/150” to intensify mountain hues, followed by RAW-based color grading and additional whites adjustments to emphasize the light direction. Micro-corrections on foreground rocks and targeted color enhancements finalize the tonal balance and visual flow toward the scene’s light source.
